# Plinth

> Open-core infrastructure for solo builders: Forms, Catch, Schema.

## Products
- Forms: https://plinth.dev/forms — static site form backend
- Catch: https://plinth.dev/catch — webhook request bin
- Schema: https://plinth.dev/schema — LLM JSON repair + JSON Schema validation

## API
- Base: https://api.plinth.dev
- Docs: https://plinth.dev/docs
- MCP: https://api.plinth.dev/mcp
- Health: https://api.plinth.dev/health

## Packages
- @plinth/schema
- @plinth/forms
- @plinth/catch

## Pricing
- Free quotas on every product
- Pro $19/mo · Team $49/mo (Polar merchant of record)
